𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗿𝗶𝗰𝗸𝘀 is taking over the Data Engineering world.

1. Introduction to Data Lakehouse | Databricks led training module
(YT : Databricks)

2. End to End Databricks series | PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Live Tables
(YT : Raja's Data Engineering)
🔗 https://lnkd.in/gan3FkTK

3. Databricks Tutorial (From Zero to Hero)
(Ansh Lamba- YT: Ansh Lamba)
🔗 https://lnkd.in/gsqC69WE

4. End to End Azure Data Engineering Project | Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory 
(YT : Mr. K Talks Tech)
🔗 https://lnkd.in/gQ7RT5kJ

5. End to End Databricks Playlist | Databricks for Data Engineering
(Subham Khandelwal - YT : Ease with Data)
🔗 https://lnkd.in/g_4X__j5

6. Unity Catalog | Introduction
🔗 https://lnkd.in/gf2PEryA

7. Databricks and PySpark | Interview Questions
🔗 https://lnkd.in/gAfqXEKZ

8. Migration from Hive Metastore to Unity Catalog
🔗 https://lnkd.in/gD7w3r7b


Databricks is here to stay ! Start your learning journey today.

Let me know if you of any other cool resources in the comments below 👇🏾
